test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: One of the diagonals of a rhombus is 70 percent of the other diagonal. What is the ratio of the area of rhombus to the square of the length of the larger diagonal?
solution:
**Given:**

One of the diagonals of the rhombus is 70 percent of the other diagonal.

**Concept used:**

Area of rhombus: 1/2 × diagonal₁ × diagonal₂

**Calculation:**

Let the first diagonal be 10x and second diagonal be 7x.(70% of 10x = 7x)

Area of rhombus = 1/2 × 10x × 7x = 35x²

Length of larger diagonal = 10x

The ratio of the area of rhombus to the square of the length of the larger diagonal = 35x² ∶ (10x)²

= 7: 20

**The required ratio is 7∶ 20.**
